values.note: 14 RV sites, 15 walk-in tent sites (7-10, 20-28; no RVs in their parking) and one walk-in group site. Ten RV sites take 29-58 ft (1, 2, 3, 5, 11, 12, 13, 15, 16, 17, all back-ins); 4 (21 ft) and 6 (16 ft) are short parallel spurs, and Oxbow site 19 (20 ft) is not reservable. One RV or trailer, 8 people and 2 vehicles a site.

values.note: Bear-proof food locker, fire ring and picnic table at every site; no trash service - pack it out. No cell service.

facilities.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/oh-be-joyful-campground ('3 vault restrooms'; 'Each campsite has a parking space, metal fire ring, picnic table, tent pad and bear proof food storage locker'; 'Drinking water ... and trash service are not available'; 'There is no cell service at this location'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Reservations are required for all sites in season: 22 sites book up to 180 days ahead, the other 7 only 4 days ahead. recreation.gov's booking rules cap a stay at 7 nights in a rolling 30 days (its notice still says 14 days). Reservation season 2026 May 22 - Sept 30 (2027: May 27 - Sept 30); recreation.gov lists the rest of the year as a first-come, first-served season. No changes within 72 hours of arrival, no refund for cancelling inside 72 hours; a no-show site is released at 2 p.m. the next day.

note: BLM campground on the east bank of the Slate River north of Crested Butte, renovated with separate RV and walk-in tent sites; a footbridge crosses the river to the Oh Be Joyful trail into the Raggeds Wilderness. The 0.3-mile access road (BLM 3220) down to the campground is steep and rough; BLM says it may not suit larger low-clearance rigs and advises scouting it first. --Claude
summary: BLM page + rec.gov + catalog: confirmed $20, no hookups, reservable on recreation.gov. flags: Phone 970-642-4940 confirmed: the BLM page and recreation.gov both give it (it is the Gunnison Field Office's line; no campground-specific number is published). recreation.gov contact email kacarson@blm.gov.
Website: recreation.gov only; add or prefer the BLM page https://www.blm.gov/visit/oh-be-joyful-campground.

Road (RV wording, not a 4WD statement): BLM - 'The access road (BLM Road 3220) into Oh Be Joyful Campground is steep and can be rough. The campground can accommodate RVs but the rough road down to the campground may not be suitable for larger low clearance rigs' and 'low clearance vehicles and larger RVs may want to scout the road before driving down'. That is a caution, not a high-clearance requirement or recommendation; the old note's 'BLM advises high clearance for larger rigs' overstated it and was reworded. Slate River Road (CR 734) is described only as the ~5-mile approach; no condition statement found.
Max stay conflict: recreation.gov's rules allow 7 consecutive nights (7 in a rolling 30 days); its notice and BLM's general limit say 14 days. Recorded 7 (what the booking system enforces).

Waterfront re-audit lead (stored riverfront, not changed): the catalog tags only RV site 1 'Proximity to Water: Riverfront'. On Esri imagery the Slate River's gravel channel runs along the west side; RV sites 1-4 sit ~30-50 m from it behind a band of conifers, and the other RV sites (5, 11-17) are ~70-120 m back on open sagebrush. The walk-in tent sites (7-10 downstream, 20-28 at the bend) are the ones right on the river. Under the open-apron rule the RV sites' claim is doubtful.
Pin 38.91388,-107.03211 is beside RV site 17, ~30 m from the 13 RV sites' centroid; OK.
Season: no operating season is stated; recreation.gov's first-come season covers Oct 1 - May 26, so none recorded. Status: no closure notice.
